verses.text: Tato yel tze k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il Jehová ko Diosal swalkan tik t'ayex, te niwan ol aj eyelk'och yuj Jehová chi' t'a yichanh juntzanhxo nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Hanhejtona' tato tze k'anab'ajej Jehová ko Diosal, ol he chapax masanil juntzanh yaxilal ol wal tik:
Ol yak' swach'k'olal t'a eyib'anh t'a yol he chonhab' yet' t'a he munlajel.
Ol yak' swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb' eyuninal, t'a yib'anh tas tzeyawej, t'a yib'anh yune' nok' he wakax, yune' nok' he kalnel yet' t'a yib'anh juntzanhxo yune' nok' he molb'etzal nok'.
Ol yak' swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh tas ol eyak'em t'a yol he mo'och yet' t'a yib'anh tas tze wa''a.
Ol yak'an swach'k'olal t'a eyib'anh b'ajtak tzex ek'i yet' yik tzex meltzajxi t'a he pat.
Ha Jehová ol ak'anoch heb' eyajk'ol t'a yol he k'ab' ayik ol yak'an owal heb' heyet'ok. T'a stzolal ol aj skot heb' t'ayex, palta sakleminak ol aj yel heb' elelal t'ayex.

Ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal t'a yib'anh tastak tzeyik' t'a he munlajel yet' t'a yib'anh masanil tas tze k'ulej. Icha wal chi' te tzalajk'olal ol ex ajek' t'a sat lum lum ol yak' Jehová chi' t'ayex.
Tato tze k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il Jehová chi', tze b'eyb'alani, ol ex yalnhejoch schonhab'ok to sik'b'ilex el yuj, icha ajnak yalani.
Haxo heb' anima t'a masanil nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol yojtakejel heb' to sik'b'il ex el yuj Jehová, ol xiw heb' t'ayex.
Ha Jehová chi' ol ex xajananok: Tzijtum ol aj eyuninal yet' yune' nok' he molb'etzal nok', jantak ol aj sat eyawb'en t'a lum lum yak'nak sti' t'a heb' ko mam kicham to ol yak' t'ayex.

Ol yak'ankot nhab' t'a yib'anh lum lum tik t'a stiempoal, icha jantak tz'och yopisio. Te wach'xonhej ol aj he munlajel. Masanil tastak ay t'ayex, ol te k'ib'cha'anh, masanto ol yal eyak'an majanil t'a tzijtumok nación. Ha exxo pax tik, malaj tas ol he k'an he majnej t'a junokxo mach.

Tato ol he k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il Jehová ko Diosal, haton masanil juntzanh swalkan t'ayex tiknaik, sat ol ex aj t'a heb' ch'ok nacional chi', haxo heb' spatiktak ol ajkan heb'. Niwan ol aj eyelk'och t'a yib'anh heb'. Malaj b'aj ol ex ak'jok ganar yuj heb'.
Icha chi' ol ex ajok, tato max eyik'el he b'a t'a spatik scheknab'il Jehová, tato max ex och tzak'an t'a spatik komon Dios, yik tzeyak'anem he b'a t'ay.
Palta tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il yet' sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová ko Diosal, haton juntzanh wan walan tik t'ayex, ol ja wal juntzanh katab' tik t'a eyib'anh:
Te chuk heyik t'a yol he chonhab' yet' t'a he munlajel.
Syalelk'ochi to malaj tas ol eyik' t'a he munlajel chi', malaj pax tas ol he wa''a.
Ol jawok ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb' eyuninal, malaj swach'il ol aj sat eyawb'en. Manh ol k'ib' yune' nok' he wakax, yune' nok' he kalnel, yune' nok' he chiwa yet' masanil nok' he molb'etzal nok'.
Chuk heyik b'ajtaknhej tzex ek'i yet' yik tzex meltzajxi t'a he pat.
Ol yak'kot ya'elal Jehová yet' ilk'olal t'a eyib'anh. Toxonhej ol ex somchajel t'a masanil tastak ol he k'ulej. Elanhchamel ol ex satel yuj chukal tze k'ulej yuj eyaktankan Jehová chi'.
Ha Jehová ol ak'ankot juntzanh ilya te ow t'a eyib'anh, masanto ol ex satel t'a sat lum lum b'aj ol ex kajnaj chi'.

Ol yak'paxkot yab'il yab'il Jehová chi' to ol ex cham yuj, k'ak'al ilya te chuk yet' he malk'ei. Haxo eyawb'en ol takjokelok. Manhxo ol yak'laj nhab', takinh ol aj smasanil. Ol och tz'aub' t'a he munlajel masanto ol yal he sateli.
Manhxalaj nhab' ol kot t'a satcha'anh. Manhxo ol yak'laj sat eyawb'en t'a lum lum chi'.
Manhxalaj nhab' ol yak'a'. Haxonhej lum pokok yet' k'e'en arena ol em yuj Jehová ko Diosal, masanto ol ex satelok.

Ha Jehová chi' ol ex ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' eyajk'o'ol. T'a stzolal ol aj he b'at t'a owal, haxo ol ajok, sakleminak ol aj eyel t'a heb'. Ol sat sk'o'ol masanil nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik ayik ol yab'an heb' tas ol ex ik'anok.
Ha nok' ostok yet' nok' kaltakte'al nok' ol chianb'at he niwanil. Manhxalaj mach ol xib'tan nok' t'ayex.
Ha Jehová ol ak'an k'ab'at he niwanil yuj mal yab'il, icha wal ajnak heb' aj Egipto. Ol k'epax kisk'oy t'ayex yet' yaxk'a yet' k'ilaj yab'il, manhxalaj yanhal juntzanh ilya chi'.
Ol ex kistalaxok, ol somchajel he k'o'ol, manhxo ol yal-laj heyilani.

Toxonhej ol ex ek' machmon t'a chimk'ualil, icha tz'aj yek' machmon heb' max ujitaxon yilani. Haxo t'a masanil tas ol he k'ulej, manhxalaj tas ol elk'och t'a wach'il. Ol ex te ixtaxelok. Ilb'ajk'olxonhej ol ex ajok. Manhxalaj mach ol ex kolanok.
Ha mach ol sb'o strato snupnaj yet' junok ix ix, ch'okxo mach ol way yet' ix. Ol he b'ok'e junok he pat, palta manhxo ol ex kajnaj t'a yo'ol. Ol eyawej junok eyuwa, palta manhxo ol he lo sat.

T'a wal eyichanh ol smilcham nok' he wakax heb' ajk'o'ol, palta manh ol he chi' jab'ok schib'ejal nok'. T'a eyichanh ol yik'b'at nok' he b'uru heb', manhxo ol yak' meltzaj nok' heb' t'ayex. Ol yik'b'at nok' he kalnel heb', manhxalaj mach ol yal skolankan nok' t'a heb'.
Eyichanh wal ol b'atkan heb' eyuninal yet' heb' ix eyisil t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il. Toxonhej ol ex k'unb'ok he maklan sjax heb', palta manhxa jab'ok tas syal eyu'uj.
Ha heb' anima manh eyojtakok, a heb' ol satanel masanil sat eyawb'en yet' jantak he munlajel. Ol ex ixtaj wal, ob'iltakxonhej ol ex ajok.
Ayik ol eyilan masanil juntzanh chi', toxonhej ol ex kistalaxkanok.
Ol yak' wal kot ya'elal Jehová t'a eyib'anh, ol k'e yab'il yaxk'a t'a sjolom he penek, t'a he xub' yet' t'a masanil he niwanil. Manhxo ol anhtaj jun ilya chi' eyu'uj.

Ol ex ik'jokb'at yuj Jehová chi' yet' he reyal sik'b'iloch eyu'uj t'a junok nación to manh eyojtakok, manh yojtakokpax heb' he mam eyicham. Hata' ol eyak'em he b'a t'a juntzanh komon Dios b'ob'il t'a te te', ma t'a k'e'en k'e'en.
Ol sat sk'ol juntzanhxo nación yab'an tas ol ex utajok. Ol aljok he pekal, ol ex b'uchjok yuj juntzanh chonhab' b'aj ol ex yik'b'at Jehová chi'.
Te niwan inhat ol eyawej, palta jab'nhej sat ol he molo', anhej nok' k'ulub' ol k'uxanb'atok.
Ol eyawej eyuwa, ol he mesani, palta manh ol he b'ixlaj sat, malaj wino ol eyuk'ej, anhej nok' yaxtaj ol lajanelok.
Ay te' olivo t'a sat he lu'um, palta malaj yaceiteal te' ol he k'ana' yujto tonhej ol k'ajb'anel sat te'.
Ay eyuninal, ay eyisil, palta manh ol ajlaj heb' heyet'ok, yujto ol ik'jokb'at heb' t'a juntzanhxo nación.
Masanil te te' syak' sat t'a he chonhab', pilan ol lajwokel te' yuj nok' k'ulub'.
Ha heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal, niwanxo ol aj yelk'och heb' t'a eyichanh, a exxo tik, manhxalaj ol aj eyelk'ochi yujto ol ex lajwokemok.
Ha heb' chi', ay tas ol yal yak'an heb' majanil, palta a exxo tik, manhxalaj tas t'ayex. Ha heb' sat ol aj t'ayex, a exxo tik spatiktakil ol ex ajkanok.
Masanil juntzanh ya'elal tik ol ja t'a eyib'anh. Ol eyab'xonhej sya'il masanto ol yal he sateli, yujto maj he k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il yet' sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová ko Diosal ix yak' t'ayex.
Ha juntzanh ya'elal tik sch'oxkot yowal sk'ol Dios t'ayex yet' t'a heb' eyinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo.
Yujto maj eyak'em he b'a t'a Jehová ko Diosal t'a tzalajk'olal yet' t'a smasanil he k'o'ol ayik ix yak'an swach'k'olal t'a eyib'anh,

yuj chi' yowalil ol eyak' serwil heb' ajk'o'ol ol yak'kot t'ayex, ol eyab' sya'il wejel, takinhtial, manh pichulal yet' masanil ya'elal. Ol eyab' wal sya'il yuj heb' eyajk'o'ol chi' masanto ol yal he sateli.

Ha heb' anima t'a junok nación te najat b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal tik, a heb' ol yik'kot Jehová t'ayex, yelk'olal ol aj skot heb' icha sjenhwi nok' ch'akb'a. Ch'ok ti'al syal heb', manh ol eyab'laj tas ol yal heb'.
Te owal anima heb'. Malaj yelk'och heb' icham anima yet' heb' unin t'a heb'.

Ol schib'at yune' nok' he molb'etzal nok' heb', ol sloanb'at sat eyawb'en te' heb', masanto ol ex ixtajwal. Manhxalaj he trigo, he wino, eyaceite, ma yune' nok' he wakax yet' yune' nok' he kalnel ol to kan yuj heb', anhej to ol ex cham yuj wejel.

Ol och hoyan heb' ajk'ol chi' t'a spatiktak he chonhab'. Ol jawok heb' t'ayex masanto ol yal yem lanhnaj smuroal he chonhab' cha'anh yajk'ei yet' b'aj skol sb'a heb' soldado ayoch yipok he k'o'ol. Masanil juntzanh chonhab' ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex, ol laj yoymitej heb'.

Ayik ol laj oymaj heb' ajk'ol chi' t'a he chonhab' chi', haxo yuj wejel ol he chianb'at eyuninal yet' eyisil ix yak' Jehová ko Diosal. Wach'chom ay junok winak t'a he kal te wach' syutej sb'a, palta yuj wejel chi' ol schib'at yuninal. Manh ol yak' jab'ok t'a yuk'tak, t'a ix yetb'eyum to xajan yuj yet' t'a juntzanhxo yuninal olto kanok.

Wach'chom ay junok ix ix manh komonok syutej sb'a t'a he kal, te b'eyum ix, malaj b'aj tz'em yok ix t'a sat lu'um, aynhejoch xanhab' ix, palta yujto manhxa tas swa ix yuj b'aj oyanoch heb' ajk'ol t'a spatiktak he chonhab' chi', ol schib'at yune' ix toto tz'alji yet' smoj yune' chi'. Manh ol yak' jab'ok ix t'a winh yetb'eyum, ma t'a juntzanhxo yune'.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal te wach', te ay smay, palta tato malaj yelk'och t'ayex, manh ol he b'eyb'alejpax masanil juntzanh cheknab'il tz'ib'ab'ilkan tik,
ol yak' wal kot niwak ya'elal ko Diosal chi' t'a eyib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh eyinhtilal. Ha wal ilya te chuk ol yak' t'a eyib'anh to manhxalaj yanhal.
Ol kot wal juntzanh ilya t'a eyib'anh, icha wal juntzanh ilya ik'annak heb' aj Egipto, haton juntzanh b'aj te xiwnak ex. Manhxo ol el-laj juntzanh ya'elal chi' t'a eyib'anh.
Ayto juntzanhxo ya'elal max b'inajlaj t'a juntzanh slolonel Dios tik ol jawok t'a eyib'anh yik tzex sateli.
Ha ex wal tik ex wetisraelal, te niwanxo he b'isul, lajan exxo icha k'e'en k'anal t'a satcha'anh, palta ol ex satelok. Manhxo niwanok ol ajkan he b'isul, tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej Jehová ko Diosal.

Icha ix aj stzalaj sk'ol sch'oxan swach'k'olal t'ayonh, ix yak'an k'ib' ko b'isul, icha pax chi' ol aj stzalaj sk'ol yuj he sateli. Elanhchamel ol aj ex yik'anxiel t'a lum lum b'aj toxo ol ex kajnaj tik.

Ha ex olto ex kanok, a Jehová ol ex saklemankanb'at b'ajtak slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Hata' ol ex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios b'ob'il t'a te te', ma t'a k'e'en k'e'en, haton komon Dios b'aj max eyak'em he b'a, manh yak'nakokpaxem sb'a heb' ko mam kicham t'ay.

Ayik ayex ek' t'a juntzanh nación chi', manh ol eyik' jab'ok eyip, malaj jab'ok tas b'aj ay eyalan eyiko'. Yujto t'a xiwk'olal ol ex ajek' yuj Jehová ta', kuseltakxonhej ol aj yilji he sat yuj ilk'olal.
Xiwk'olal ol ex ajek' t'a masanil tiempo yuj he chamel. Ol ex te xiw t'a k'ualil yet' t'ak'walil.
Ol ex te xiw wal sik'lab'il yuj juntzanh te ay smay ol heyila'. Ha t'a k'inhib'alil ol eyala': Tzok wal k'ik'b'i, xe chama. Haxo t'ak'walil ol eyalanxi: Tzok sakb'i, xe chama.

Wach'chom ix yal Jehová to manhxa b'ak'inh tzex meltzaj t'a Egipto, palta a ol ex ak'anxib'at ta' t'a yol barco. Hata' ol he chonhoch he b'a schekab'ok heb' eyajk'ol chi', palta manhxalaj mach ol ex mananok, xchi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb'.
